name: 雄霸天下III
english_name: Xiong Ba Tian Xia III (Lord of the World III)
english_description: A genuine 1997-2001-era mudlib by its own internal readme, descended from the "Fengyun" lineage. The original archive shipped as four split zip volumes containing twelve directory-by-directory tar.gz files rather than a flat directory tree. Character creation blends Western MUD-style classes (a choice between enchanter and fighter) with a wuxia setting, and death leads into an unusually elaborate five-stage ghost journey narrated by the deity Bai Wuchang.
